feeds.title: Online Learning and Distance Education Resources
feeds.description: The blog by Tony Bates is meant as a resource for students, faculty, and academic administrators interested in online learning. Dr. Tony Bates is the author of eleven books in the field of online learning and distance education.

feeds.title: 2 Peas and a Dog Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kristy, the teacher behind 2 Peas and a Dog. I am a middle school teacher in Canada. I love writing this blog because it allows me to share my passion for teaching and time-saving ideas with other teachers around the world.

feeds.title: Madly Learning Blog
feeds.description: I am Patti. I am coffee and wine drinking Canadian mom of 3, married to my partner in crime and teacher of many amazing students over the last 13 years. I have taught grades 3-6 and hold both my reading and ESL specialist.Madly Learning is my corner of the internet where I help teachers learn to fit it all together to make teaching easier through, inquiry based learning, universal design, and differentiated instruction.

feeds.title: Toronto Teacher Mom
feeds.description: Diana is a mother of two children and works as an elementary French teacher in Toronto, Ontario. She launched her blog in 2006, sharing her thoughts as a mother, a teacher, and everything in between. I also feature articles on technology, education, local events, resources for teachers, and more.

feeds.title: Mrs. Bremer's Class
feeds.description: My name is Anita, and I have taught in the primary grades (K-2) for over 20 years. I love sharing my classroom ideas and teaching tips. I spend my days creating quality learning resources for K-2 classrooms to help students love learning, and to make life easier for busy teachers like YOU.

feeds.title: Runde's Room
feeds.description: Runde's Room blog is an education blog by the author Jennifer Runde. Jennifer has been teaching full time for 10 years.

feeds.title: Paul Maharg
feeds.description: Hi, I'm a Distinguished Professor of Practice - Legal Education at Osgoode Hall Law School, York University, Ontario. I publish largely on legal education but also in law and literature, and occasionally legal critique.

feeds.title: Reading Power Gear
feeds.description: My name is Adrienne Gear and I am an elementary teacher in Vancouver, Canada, where I have taught for over 20 years. This blog is a place for me to share some of my lesson ideas and books I love with others, to reflect on my practice, and to explore my thinking around reading and writing.

feeds.title: Musing Mathematically Blog
feeds.description: The blog focuses on maths topic and simplifying the process of solving the problem. It also features functions, graphic and quadratic topics. Nat Banting is a full-time classroom mathematics teacher in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada.

feeds.title: Joyful Learning in the Early Years
feeds.description: I am a Reggio Emilia inspired Full Day Kindergarten teacher and mother to three young children. This blog is meant as a communication tool for the families of our children and as a learning tool for the many educators who follow us.

feeds.title: Mrs. Brosseau's Binder
feeds.description: A blog about Teaching Science, Physics, Astronomy and Chemistry using brain-based learning. Michelle is a math & science teacher dedicated to making learning fun through games, puzzles, foldables, interactive lessons and more.

feeds.title: Dr. Jennifer J. MacDonald Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Jennifer MacDonald is a Director of English Language Studies at Dalhousie University, UCL Institute of Education alumna, Writer, and linguistic junkie. This is my space for reflection and conversation on linguistics and language teaching.

feeds.title: Virtual Writing Tutor- Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a collection of articles about this website, about pedagogy, grammar, writing, testimonials, and information about Nicholas. VirtualWritingTutor is a free English grammar checker by Nicholas Walker that finds common spelling and grammar errors for learners of English as a Language.

feeds.title: Shelley Gray Teaching Blog
feeds.description: I'm Shelley, and my philosophy is simple. I want your students to LOVE math. I believe that math needs to be exciting, meaningful, and taught in a way that helps students make important connections between concepts. I want to empower you to bring maths to life for your students.

feeds.title: mycampusGPS Blog
feeds.description: A blog for parents of high school students preparing for university in Canada - scholarship prep, career exploration & admission. Janet MacDonald has over 10 years of experience with university admissions and scholarship coaching which she uses for Canadian students win hundreds of thousands of dollars in scholarships.

feeds.title: Teacher Talk
feeds.description: Teaching blog with a focus on Middle / High school students covering ELA, Science, and Social Studies. Addie Williams is a coffee drinker, hiker, skier, dog mamma, wife, teacher, and reader.

feeds.title: Create Dream Explore Blog
feeds.description: My name is Heidi. I began this blog as a way to share my ideas and resources with my fellow educators. I've been in the trenches for over 15 years (all in elementary education) and I'm a mom to 3 beauties and have a wonderfully supportive husband! I understand how precious your time is so I hope you're able to find some ideas here to take back to your classroom.

feeds.title: Teaching FSL
feeds.description: I'm Madame Aiello, a Canadian middle school French teacher, creator of teaching materials, mom, Francophile, continually striving for personal and professional growth.

feeds.title: Ontario Teachers' Blog
feeds.description: I am your host, Tammy Gaudun, and I'm hoping to create a site where teachers can share resources and experiences.

feeds.title: Teaching in a Fishbowl
feeds.description: I'm Kristen Thompson and I serve as the divisional Coordinator of ICT for the Mountain View School Division overseeing technology programming. This blog is about my experiences as an educator.

feeds.title: ESE/TE Blog
feeds.description: This website is the digital home of the ESE-TE Standing Committee of the Canadian Network for Environmental Education and Communication, (EECOM). The ESE-TE Committee is dedicated to advancing and supporting the development of high quality Environmental & Sustainability Education (ESE) in Teacher Education (TE) in Canada through research, policy, and professional development.

feeds.title: Mrs. Beattie's Classroom Blog
feeds.description: Mrs. Beattie's Classroom helps overworked teachers create engaging, differentiated classrooms without sacrificing their personal and family lives.

feeds.title: Teach Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1993, TEACH Magazine delivers pragmatic tools and resources to K-12 educators everywhere. TEACH stands as an open forum for discussion supporting good teachers and teaching while promoting innovation in education. Being a teacher doesn't mean you stop learning. TEACH is for you, the professional educator.

feeds.title: Teachers to Go Blog
feeds.description: Julie Diamond is a certified teacher in Canada and the founder of Teachers to Go. Teachers To Go, Inc. is a unique tutoring service that matches students with provincially certified teachers who expertly create a program based on the individual student's needs and strengths.
